title: Understanding where to ask for learning support
situation: A learner is finding course instructions difficult to follow and wants to know what kinds of support they can ask about.

workflow.barrierOrConcern: Course instructions are difficult to follow.
boundedSupportOptions: Ask the learning provider whether instructions are available in a clearer or alternative format.
Ask what other supported ways to participate in the learning task are available.
workflow.reviewOrNextAction: Record the option chosen, who will respond, what happens next and when the learner can review whether it is helping.

navigation.action: Describe the learning task or barrier in your own words without needing a diagnosis.
navigation.why: Support conversations can begin with what is making participation difficult.

navigation.action: Ask the learning provider what support, adjustments, accessible formats or alternative ways to participate are available.
navigation.why: The provider can explain its process and who is responsible for responding.

navigation.action: Record the option you choose, what will happen next and when it will be reviewed.
navigation.why: A clear next action makes it easier to check whether the support is helping.

boundaries: This example is general information, not diagnosis or clinical advice.
It does not determine legal entitlement, regulatory compliance or formal assessment outcomes.
It contains no real learner, family, provider or client data.
